description: This Dart source file provides localization support for a Flutter application. It handles loading localized strings from ARB-like JSON assets, offering minimal localization functionality without using code generation, and includes a controller for managing runtime locale changes.

classes.name: AppLocalizations
classes.description: Provides localized strings for the app, loads localization data from ARB-like JSON files based on the current locale, and offers a translation method.

classes.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class responsible for providing instances of AppLocalizations for supported locales.

classes.name: AppLocaleController
classes.description: Manages the application's current locale at runtime, allowing it to be updated and notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.of
methods.description: Retrieves the current AppLocalizations instance from the widget tree.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.load
methods.description: Loads localized strings asynchronously based on the provided locale.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.t
methods.description: Retrieves the localized string for a given key, or returns the key if not found.

methods.name: AppLocaleController.setLocale
methods.description: Updates the application's locale and notifies listeners.
